_comment: Generated for Maszynka.pro Discord bot hosting. Import into Pterodactyl PTDL_v2.
name: Maszynka.pro Discord Bot - Node.js
author: pantherpaykey@users.noreply.github.com
description: Production Node.js egg for Discord bots with bundled Maszynka.pro template support.
startup: if [ -f /home/container/.git ] || [ -d /home/container/.git ]; then if [ "${AUTO_UPDATE:-0}" = "1" ]; then git pull --ff-only || exit 1; fi; fi; echo "[Maszynka] Runtime ready"; if [ -n "${STARTUP_COMMAND:-}" ]; then eval "${STARTUP_COMMAND}"; else node "$MAIN_FILE" $STARTUP_ARGS; fi

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
echo "[Maszynka] Installing Node.js Discord bot"
if [ "${USER_UPLOAD:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  echo "[Maszynka] USER_UPLOAD=1, skipping git clone"
else
  if [ -z "${GIT_REPO:-}" ]; then echo "GIT_REPO is not configured"; exit 1; fi
  rm -rf repo-tmp
  git clone --depth 1 --branch "${GIT_BRANCH:-main}" "${GIT_REPO}" repo-tmp
  shopt -s dotglob
  if [ -d "repo-tmp/${APP_DIR}" ]; then cp -R "repo-tmp/${APP_DIR}"/* .; else echo "APP_DIR not found: ${APP_DIR}"; exit 1; fi
  rm -rf repo-tmp
fi
if [ "${AUTO_INSTALL_DEPS:-1}" = "1" ]; then
  if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci; elif [ -f package.json ]; then npm install; fi
fi
echo "[Maszynka] Install complete"

variables.name: GIT REPO
variables.description: Git repository URL used by the installer.

variables.name: APP DIR
variables.description: Directory inside GIT_REPO copied into the server.

variables.name: STARTUP COMMAND
variables.description: Optional full startup command. Takes precedence when set.

variables.name: AUTO UPDATE
variables.description: Run git pull --ff-only before startup when the server directory is a git repository.

variables.name: USER UPLOAD
variables.description: Skip git clone during install and let the user upload files.

variables.name: DISCORD TOKEN
variables.description: Discord bot token exposed as DISCORD_TOKEN environment variable.
